$comment: Paired flag A/B for the CP heat-outlet guard (Phase 1 of the CP-side compliance fix).

Mechanism under test: heat-producing CPs (P2H/G2H/CHP) inject q_mw_heat into low-flow DHS junctions and drive t_k past the 403.15 K ceiling (eval_full_v2_20260711: hot CP outlets, e.g. node 371 on simbench_lv, dominate constraint-compliance failures at 98%). The guard (enable_cp_heat_outlet_guard) holds an AIMD regulation ceiling per CP, enforced against all L3 commits in apply_regulate and self-actuated for the born regulation=1.0 state.
Arms: {} = guard on (new default); guard off = eval_full_v2 baseline behavior.

Judge on: claims__constraint_compliance detail temperature n_violations/worst_overshoot (expect ~0 on guard arm), heat served fraction (expect neutral), outcomes__cp_generation n_active/heat_mw (CP wake-up must survive), PWSF, cp_heat_outlet_relief / cp_regulate_capped_to_heat_ceiling event health.
name: ab_cp_heat_guard
